description: Rows from one CSV file of a dataset, at most 50 a call. Filter with "where" (column: text the value must contain). Files over 200 KB are not read whole: filter by firm_slug to read one firm, or use the download address in the result.

file.description: File name from get_dataset. Default: the dataset's first CSV file.

where.description: Column name to text; a row is kept when the value contains the text (case-insensitive).

name: read_rows
title: Read rows from a dataset file
